headline: Kazakhstan-Kyrgyzstan Bilateral Trade Expands 17.9% Through September
summary: Bilateral trade turnover between Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan reached $1.99 billion in the first nine months of 2026, an increase of 17.9% compared to the same period last year.
why: Trade flows between Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan represent a significant economic corridor within the Eurasian Economic Union.
